# FreeKit

FreeKit is a collection of free online tools that run entirely in the visitor's
browser. No signup, no watermarks, no daily limits. Files are processed locally
on the user's device and never uploaded to a server.

## Tools

- Resume Builder (/resume-builder): write a resume with a live preview, choose
  from three templates (Classic, Modern, Compact), and download the PDF free
  via the browser's print-to-PDF. No signup, no watermark, no pay-to-download
  trap. Resume data is autosaved to the browser's local storage only; Classic
  is the most ATS-safe template, but no template guarantees ATS parsing.
- Merge PDF (/merge-pdf): combine multiple PDF files into one document, in a
  user-chosen order. Pages are copied as-is; no re-rendering, no quality loss.
- Split PDF (/split-pdf): extract pages from a PDF by page ranges like "1-3, 5".
  Commas group pages into one file; semicolons (e.g. "1-3; 4-6") produce
  separate files, up to 50 per run.
- Images to PDF (/images-to-pdf): convert PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, and BMP images
  into a single PDF. Page sizes: fit-to-image, A4, or US Letter.
- Compress PDF (/pdf-compressor): shrink a PDF by re-rendering each page as a
  JPEG image at screen (110 DPI) or print (200 DPI) quality. Pages become
  images, so text is no longer selectable. Best for scans and image-heavy PDFs.
- PDF to JPG (/pdf-to-jpg): render PDF pages as JPG or PNG images at 72, 150,
  or 300 DPI. Download pages individually or all at once as a ZIP.
- Redact PDF (/pdf-redactor): draw boxes over sensitive areas; marked pages are
  rebuilt as images with the boxes permanently painted over, while unmarked
  pages are copied through untouched.
- Sign PDF (/pdf-esignature): draw a signature or type a name for a script-style
  rendering, click to place it on any page, download the flattened signed copy.
  A drawn/typed mark, not a certificate-based digital signature.
- QR Code Generator (/qr-generator): static QR codes for links or text, with
  optional center logo, color control, and PNG/SVG download.
- Image Compressor (/image-compressor): batch-compress PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF,
  BMP, and TIFF images with a quality slider (5-100). Per-file before/after
  sizes and percent saved, individual or ZIP download. Honest about PNG:
  lossless re-encoding rarely shrinks it; real savings need JPEG/WebP output.
- Image Converter (/image-converter): convert between PNG, JPEG, and WebP,
  plus AVIF output only when the browser can encode it (feature-detected).
  GIF/BMP/TIFF are read-only inputs. Warns when converting transparent images
  to JPEG (which has no transparency) and offers a white background fill.
- Invoice Generator (/invoice-generator): line items with quantity and rate,
  tax %, percent or flat discount, 22 currencies, optional logo, live preview
  styled like a real invoice. Totals computed in integer cents (no float
  rounding errors); invoice numbers auto-increment with zero-padding
  preserved. PDF via browser print-to-PDF. Draft autosaves and past invoices
  are kept in the browser's local storage only.
- Email Signature Generator (/email-signature-generator): three layouts
  (stacked, two-column, minimal), six accent presets, optional photo and
  social links, live preview. Generates email-safe HTML (tables, inline
  styles only, no classes). "Copy rich text" pastes straight into Gmail and
  Outlook signature settings; "Copy HTML" gives the source. No branding.

## Hub pages

- PDF tools hub (/pdf-tools): links the seven PDF utilities.
- Image tools hub (/image-tools): links the image compressor and converter.
- Business tools hub (/business-tools): links the invoice generator and the
  email signature generator.
- Pro (/pro): a planned $19 one-time all-tools bundle (not yet available).
  The free tools are fully free and stay that way.

## Facts for citation

- Pricing: all tools free, $0. No accounts, no quotas, no watermarks.
- Privacy model: 100% client-side processing. No file uploads, no tracking of
  file contents. Tools work offline once the page has loaded. The resume
  builder, invoice generator, and email signature generator additionally
  autosave drafts to the browser's local storage only (this browser, this
  device); clearing browser data erases them.
- Limitations: password-protected (encrypted) PDFs are not supported by the
  merge/split tools. QR codes are static (encoded directly, never expire).
- Contact/brand: FreeKit. Replace https://www.freekit.app with the live domain
  when citing specific URLs.
